questions.text: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा कथन 'सोवियत प्रणाली' के बारे में सही नहीं है ?
questions.text_english: Which one of the following statements about the 'Soviet System' is not true ?

options.A: सभी नागरिकों के लिए एक सुनिश्चित न्यूनतम जीवन स्तर
options.C: उद्योगों और भूमि का निजी स्वामित्व

options_english.A: A minimum standard of living ensured for all citizens
options_english.C: Private ownership of industries and land

questions.solution: The correct answer is (C) Private ownership of industries and land. The Soviet System was based on socialist principles that advocated state ownership of all means of production, including industries and land. Private ownership was strictly prohibited under this system. Options A, B, and D are all true features of the Soviet System — it guaranteed a minimum standard of living, provided subsidised health services, and ran extensive welfare schemes for all citizens.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (C) है — उद्योगों और भूमि का निजी स्वामित्व। सोवियत प्रणाली समाजवादी सिद्धांतों पर आधारित थी जिसमें उत्पादन के सभी साधनों पर राज्य का स्वामित्व होता था। निजी स्वामित्व पूर्णतः प्रतिबंधित था। विकल्प A, B और D सोवियत प्रणाली की सही विशेषताएँ हैं।

questions.text:
निम्नलिखित घटनाओं को कालक्रमानुसार व्यवस्थित कीजिए :
(i) रूस, यूक्रेन और बेलारूस ने सोवियत संघ के समाप्त होने की घोषणा की
(ii) मिखाइल गोर्बाचेव सोवियत संघ की कम्युनिस्ट पार्टी के महासचिव बने
(iii) रूस में सोवियत क्रांति
(iv) भारत-रूस रणनीतिक समझौता किया गया
सही विकल्प चुनिए :
questions.text_english:
Arrange the following events in chronological order :
(i) Russia, Ukraine and Belarus declared that Soviet Union was disbanded
(ii) Mikhail Gorbachev became the General Secretary of the Communist Party of Soviet Union
(iii) Soviet Revolution in Russia
(iv) Indo-Russian Strategic Agreement was made
Choose the correct option :
questions.solution: The correct answer is (B) (iii), (ii), (i), (iv). The chronological order is: The Soviet Revolution in Russia took place in 1917, Mikhail Gorbachev became General Secretary of the Communist Party of the Soviet Union in 1985, Russia, Ukraine and Belarus declared the Soviet Union disbanded in December 1991, and the Indo-Russian Strategic Agreement was signed in 2001. Options A, C, and D do not reflect this correct historical sequence.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (B) है — (iii), (ii), (i), (iv)। सही क्रम है: रूस में सोवियत क्रांति 1917 में हुई, मिखाइल गोर्बाचेव 1985 में महासचिव बने, 1991 में सोवियत संघ के विघटन की घोषणा हुई और 2001 में भारत-रूस रणनीतिक समझौता हुआ।

questions.text: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा संयुक्त राष्ट्र संघ का अंग नहीं है ?
questions.text_english: Which one of the following is not an organ of the United Nations Organization ?
questions.solution: The correct answer is (D) UNESCO. UNESCO (United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization) is a specialised agency of the United Nations, not one of its six principal organs. The six principal organs of the UN are the General Assembly, Security Council, Secretariat, International Court of Justice, Economic and Social Council, and the Trusteeship Council. Options A, B, and C — the Security Council, General Assembly, and Secretariat — are all principal organs of the UN.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (D) यूनेस्को है। यूनेस्को संयुक्त राष्ट्र की एक विशेष एजेंसी है, न कि उसका मुख्य अंग। संयुक्त राष्ट्र के छह प्रमुख अंग हैं — महासभा, सुरक्षा परिषद्, सचिवालय, अंतरराष्ट्रीय न्यायालय, आर्थिक एवं सामाजिक परिषद् और न्यासिता परिषद्।
questions.chapter: The United Nations and its Organisations

questions.text: उस देश को चुनिए जो संयुक्त राष्ट्र सुरक्षा परिषद् का स्थायी सदस्य नहीं है।
questions.text_english: Choose the country which is not a permanent member of the UN Security Council.
questions.solution: The correct answer is (C) Japan. Japan is not a permanent member of the UN Security Council. The five permanent members (P5) of the UN Security Council are the United States, the United Kingdom, France, Russia, and China. Japan is only a non-permanent member and has served several terms in that capacity. Options A, B, and D — China, Russia, and the United Kingdom — are all permanent members of the Security Council.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (C) जापान है। जापान संयुक्त राष्ट्र सुरक्षा परिषद् का स्थायी सदस्य नहीं है। पाँच स्थायी सदस्य (P5) हैं — अमेरिका, ब्रिटेन, फ्रांस, रूस और चीन। चीन, रूस और यूनाइटेड किंगडम तीनों स्थायी सदस्य हैं।
questions.chapter: The United Nations and its Organisations

questions.text:
अभिकथन (A) : भारत में वैश्वीकरण का प्रतिरोध ट्रेड यूनियनों और किसान हितैषी मज़दूरों की ओर से हुआ है।
कारण (R) : बहुराष्ट्रीय निगमों ने लघु स्तरीय उद्योगों एवं कृषि के हितों को नुकसान पहुँचाया है।
questions.text_english:
Assertion (A) : Resistance to globalisation in India has come from Trade Unions and workforce representing farmers' interests.
Reason (R) : Multinational Corporations have damaged the interests of small scale industries and agriculture.
questions.instruction_line: प्रश्न संख्या 5 के लिए, दो कथन दिए गए हैं – जिनमें एक को अभिकथन (A) तथा दूसरे को कारण (R) द्वारा अंकित किया गया है। इन कथनों को ध्यान से पढ़िए और नीचे दिए गए विकल्पों (A), (B), (C) और (D) में से सही विकल्प चुनिए।
questions.instruction_line_english: For Question number 5, two statements are given — one labelled as Assertion (A) and the other labelled as Reason (R). Read these statements carefully and choose the correct option as the answer from the options (A), (B), (C) and (D) given below.

options.A: अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) दोनों सही हैं और कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या करता है।
options.B: अभिकथन (A) और कारण (R) दोनों सही हैं, परंतु कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं करता है।
options.C: अभिकथन (A) सही है, परंतु कारण (R) ग़लत है।
options.D: अभिकथन (A) ग़लत है, परंतु कारण (R) सही है।

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of the Assertion (A).
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of the Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.

questions.solution: The correct answer is (A). Both the Assertion and the Reason are true, and the Reason correctly explains the Assertion. Trade unions and farmer-worker organisations in India have indeed resisted globalisation because multinational corporations have undercut small-scale industries by flooding the market with cheaper goods, and large-scale agribusiness has harmed traditional farming interests. The Reason thus directly explains why such resistance has emerged, making option A the correct choice.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (A) है। अभिकथन और कारण दोनों सत्य हैं और कारण, अभिकथन की सही व्याख्या करता है। बहुराष्ट्रीय कंपनियों ने लघु उद्योगों को नुकसान पहुँचाया है जिस कारण ट्रेड यूनियनों और किसान-मज़दूर संगठनों ने वैश्वीकरण का विरोध किया।

questions.text: वैश्वीकरण का निम्नलिखित में से किसके प्रवाह से सम्बन्ध है ?
questions.text_english: Globalisation is related to the flow of which of the following ?
questions.solution: The correct answer is (B) Ideas. Globalisation refers to the increasing flow and interconnection of ideas, capital, goods, services, people, and technology across national boundaries. Among the given options, the flow of ideas best captures the essence of globalisation as a concept. Rivers, air, and pollution represent natural phenomena and are not what globalisation specifically describes as its defining flows.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (B) विचारों का है। वैश्वीकरण का अर्थ है — विचारों, पूँजी, वस्तुओं, सेवाओं और तकनीक का राष्ट्रीय सीमाओं के पार प्रवाह। विकल्पों में 'विचारों का प्रवाह' वैश्वीकरण की अवधारणा को सबसे सही रूप से व्यक्त करता है।

questions.text: भारत में प्रथम आम चुनाव किस वर्ष में हुए थे ?
questions.text_english: In which year were the first General Elections held in India ?
questions.solution: The correct answer is (D) 1952. The first General Elections in independent India were held from October 1951 to February 1952, and the results were declared in 1952. This was a landmark event as India became the world's largest democracy to conduct universal adult franchise elections. Options A (1948), B (1949), and C (1950) are incorrect — 1950 was the year India became a Republic.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (D) 1952 है। स्वतंत्र भारत में प्रथम आम चुनाव अक्टूबर 1951 से फरवरी 1952 के बीच हुए और परिणाम 1952 में घोषित हुए। 1950 में भारत गणतंत्र बना था। 1948 और 1949 के विकल्प गलत हैं।

questions.text: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा राजनीतिक नेता कम्युनिस्ट पार्टी ऑफ इंडिया से संबंधित था ?
questions.text_english: Which one of the following political leaders belonged to the Communist Party of India ?
questions.solution: The correct answer is (B) A.K. Gopalan. A.K. Gopalan (Ayillyath Kuttiari Gopalan) was a prominent leader of the Communist Party of India and served as its Parliamentary Party leader for many years. C. Rajagopalachari was associated with the Indian National Congress and later founded the Swatantra Party. Acharya Narendra Dev was a leader of the Socialist Party. Dr. B.R. Ambedkar founded the Scheduled Castes Federation and later the Republican Party of India.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (B) ए.के. गोपालन है। ए.के. गोपालन भारतीय कम्युनिस्ट पार्टी के प्रमुख नेता थे। सी. राजगोपालाचारी कांग्रेस से थे, आचार्य नरेन्द्र देव सोशलिस्ट पार्टी से और डॉ. अम्बेडकर ने रिपब्लिकन पार्टी की स्थापना की थी।

questions.text: 'योजना आयोग' के बारे में सही कथन चुनिए :
questions.text_english: Choose the correct statement about 'Planning Commission' :

options.B: योजना आयोग का गठन 1952 में किया गया था।
options.C: इसकी सिफारिशें राज्य सरकारों के लिए बाध्यकारी थीं।
options.D: इसकी भूमिका सिफारिशें करने के लिए एक सलाहकार की थी।

options_english.B: Planning Commission was set up in 1952.
options_english.C: Its recommendations were binding on the State Governments.
options_english.D: It had an advisory role to make recommendations.

questions.solution: The correct answer is (D) It had an advisory role to make recommendations. The Planning Commission of India, set up in 1950 by a cabinet resolution, had no constitutional status and its recommendations were not binding on state governments. It served as an advisory body that made recommendations for economic planning. Option A is wrong as it had no constitutional status; Option B is wrong as it was established in 1950, not 1952; Option C is wrong as its recommendations were not binding.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (D) है। योजना आयोग की भूमिका केवल सलाहकार की थी — यह सिफारिशें करता था। इसे 1950 में एक कैबिनेट प्रस्ताव द्वारा स्थापित किया गया था, इसे संवैधानिक दर्जा प्राप्त नहीं था और राज्यों पर इसकी सिफारिशें बाध्यकारी नहीं थीं।

questions.text: प्रारंभिक वर्षों में योजनाकारों का मूल उद्देश्य क्या था ?
questions.text_english: One of the basic aims of the planners in the initial years was to _______ .

options.A: राष्ट्रीय आय के स्तर को उठाना था
options.B: देश की सैन्य शक्ति में वृद्धि करनी थी
options.D: शिक्षा के स्तर को उठाना था

options_english.A: Raise the level of national income
options_english.B: Raise the military power of the country

questions.solution: The correct answer is (A) Raise the level of national income. The primary objective of economic planners in India's initial years after independence was to raise the level of national income and ensure rapid economic growth to alleviate poverty and improve living standards. The first Five-Year Plan (1951–56) had this as its central goal. Raising military power, political awareness, or educational standards, though important, were not the basic economic aim of the early planners.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (A) है। स्वतंत्रता के बाद प्रारंभिक वर्षों में योजनाकारों का मूल उद्देश्य राष्ट्रीय आय के स्तर को उठाना और आर्थिक विकास सुनिश्चित करना था ताकि गरीबी दूर हो और जीवन स्तर में सुधार हो।

questions.text: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-से प्रधानमंत्री के कार्यकाल में नए आर्थिक सुधारों की शुरुआत हुई ?
questions.text_english: During the tenure of which Prime Minister were the new economic reforms started ?
questions.solution: The correct answer is (C) Rajiv Gandhi. The new economic reforms in India were initiated during the tenure of Prime Minister Rajiv Gandhi in the mid-1980s, when policies of liberalisation — particularly in the technology and telecom sectors — were introduced. The major reform package of 1991 (LPG reforms) was formally launched under P.V. Narasimha Rao, but the groundwork was laid by Rajiv Gandhi. Among the given options, Rajiv Gandhi is the most appropriate answer for initiating new economic reforms.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (C) राजीव गाँधी है। भारत में नए आर्थिक सुधारों की शुरुआत 1980 के दशक के मध्य में राजीव गाँधी के कार्यकाल में हुई, जब तकनीक और दूरसंचार क्षेत्र में उदारीकरण की नीतियाँ लागू की गईं।

questions.text: 2004 के चुनावों में भारतीय राष्ट्रीय काँग्रेस द्वारा बनाए गए गठबंधन का सही नाम चुनिए।
questions.text_english: Choose the correct name of the alliance made by the Indian National Congress in the elections of 2004.
questions.solution: The correct answer is (B) United Progressive Alliance (UPA). In the 2004 general elections, the Indian National Congress formed and led the United Progressive Alliance (UPA), which won the elections and formed the government under Prime Minister Manmohan Singh. The National Democratic Alliance (NDA) was the BJP-led coalition. The National Front was a coalition from 1989, and the United Front was a coalition from 1996.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (B) संयुक्त प्रगतिशील गठबंधन (UPA) है। 2004 के आम चुनावों में भारतीय राष्ट्रीय काँग्रेस ने संयुक्त प्रगतिशील गठबंधन (UPA) का गठन किया और चुनाव जीतकर डॉ. मनमोहन सिंह के नेतृत्व में सरकार बनाई। NDA भाजपा के नेतृत्व वाला गठबंधन था।

questions.text: पाकिस्तान के किन्हीं चार सैनिक शासकों के नाम लिखिए।
questions.text_english: Name any four military rulers of Pakistan.

key_points: General Ayub Khan
General Yahya Khan
General Zia-ul-Haq
General Pervez Musharraf
key_points_hindi: जनरल अयूब खान
जनरल याह्या खान
जनरल ज़िया-उल-हक
जनरल परवेज़ मुशर्रफ

questions.solution: Pakistan has been ruled by military dictators several times in its history. The four prominent military rulers of Pakistan are: (1) General Ayub Khan, who seized power in 1958, (2) General Yahya Khan, who ruled from 1969 to 1971, (3) General Zia-ul-Haq, who overthrew Zulfikar Ali Bhutto in 1977 and ruled until 1988, and (4) General Pervez Musharraf, who took power in a coup in 1999 and ruled until 2008.
questions.solution_hindi: पाकिस्तान के चार प्रमुख सैनिक शासक: (1) जनरल अयूब खान — 1958 में सत्ता पर कब्जा किया, (2) जनरल याह्या खान — 1969 से 1971 तक शासन किया, (3) जनरल ज़िया-उल-हक — 1977 में भुट्टो को उखाड़कर 1988 तक सत्ता में रहे, और (4) जनरल परवेज़ मुशर्रफ — 1999 में तख्तापलट कर 2008 तक शासन किया।

questions.text: मूलवासियों को परिभाषित कीजिए।
questions.text_english: Define the Indigenous people.

key_points: Descendants of original inhabitants of a region before colonisation
Distinct cultural identity, language, and customs
Often marginalised by dominant societies
key_points_hindi: उपनिवेशीकरण से पहले के मूल निवासियों के वंशज
विशिष्ट सांस्कृतिक पहचान, भाषा और रीति-रिवाज
अक्सर प्रभुत्वशाली समाजों द्वारा हाशिए पर धकेले गए

questions.solution: Indigenous people, also called native or aboriginal people, are the original inhabitants of a territory who were living there before colonisers or settlers arrived. They have their own distinct languages, cultures, traditions, and social structures that differ from the dominant society. These communities have historically been marginalised, displaced, or subjected to discrimination by more powerful groups. Examples include Aboriginal Australians, Native Americans, and various tribal communities in Asia and Africa.
questions.solution_hindi: मूलवासी (आदिवासी या स्वदेशी लोग) किसी क्षेत्र के वे मूल निवासी हैं जो उपनिवेशवादियों या बाहरी लोगों के आने से पहले से वहाँ रहते आए हैं। इनकी अपनी विशिष्ट भाषा, संस्कृति, परंपराएँ और सामाजिक संरचनाएँ होती हैं। ऐतिहासिक रूप से इन्हें प्रभुत्वशाली समाजों द्वारा हाशिए पर रखा गया है। उदाहरण: ऑस्ट्रेलिया के एबोरिजिनल, अमेरिका के मूल अमेरिकी और एशिया-अफ्रीका के आदिवासी समुदाय।

questions.text: वैश्वीकरण के कोई दो राजनीतिक परिणाम स्पष्ट कीजिए।
questions.text_english: Explain any two political consequences of Globalisation.

key_points: Erosion of state sovereignty — states lose control over decision-making to international bodies and MNCs
Rise of non-state actors — NGOs, international organisations gain political influence
key_points_hindi: राज्य की संप्रभुता का क्षरण — अंतरराष्ट्रीय संस्थाओं और बहुराष्ट्रीय कंपनियों के कारण राज्यों की निर्णय-क्षमता कम होती है
गैर-राज्य कारकों का उदय — NGOs और अंतरराष्ट्रीय संगठनों का राजनीतिक प्रभाव बढ़ता है

questions.solution: Globalisation has significant political consequences. First, it has led to the erosion of state sovereignty, as states are increasingly compelled to follow the norms set by international organisations such as the WTO, IMF, and World Bank, reducing their autonomy in policy-making. Second, globalisation has strengthened the role of non-state actors such as NGOs, multinational corporations, and international pressure groups, which now actively shape global political decisions alongside nation-states.
questions.solution_hindi: वैश्वीकरण के दो प्रमुख राजनीतिक परिणाम हैं। प्रथम, राज्य की संप्रभुता का कमजोर होना — WTO, IMF जैसे अंतरराष्ट्रीय संगठनों के दबाव में राज्यों को अपनी नीतियाँ बदलनी पड़ती हैं। द्वितीय, गैर-राज्य कारकों जैसे NGOs और बहुराष्ट्रीय कंपनियों का राजनीतिक प्रभाव बढ़ा है जो अब वैश्विक निर्णयों को प्रभावित करते हैं।

questions.text: पहले तीन आम चुनावों में काँग्रेस पार्टी के प्रभुत्व के कोई दो कारण उजागर कीजिए।
questions.text_english: Highlight any two reasons for the dominance of Congress Party in the first three general elections.

key_points: Legacy of the freedom struggle — Congress had led the national movement, giving it unmatched credibility
Charismatic leadership — leaders like Nehru had a mass appeal across regions, castes, and communities
key_points_hindi: स्वतंत्रता संग्राम की विरासत — कांग्रेस ने राष्ट्रीय आंदोलन का नेतृत्व किया था
करिश्माई नेतृत्व — नेहरू जैसे नेताओं की सभी वर्गों में व्यापक अपील थी

questions.solution: The Congress Party dominated the first three general elections in India for two main reasons. First, it had the powerful legacy of leading the independence movement, which gave it enormous public trust and recognition across the country. Voters who had lived through colonial rule naturally supported the party that had won them freedom. Second, the party had charismatic and widely respected leaders like Jawaharlal Nehru whose appeal cut across caste, community, and regional lines, helping Congress consolidate votes from diverse sections of society.
questions.solution_hindi: पहले तीन आम चुनावों में कांग्रेस के प्रभुत्व के दो प्रमुख कारण थे। प्रथम, स्वतंत्रता संग्राम की विरासत — कांग्रेस ने राष्ट्रीय आंदोलन का नेतृत्व किया था जिससे जनता में उसका अत्यधिक विश्वास था। द्वितीय, जवाहरलाल नेहरू जैसे करिश्माई नेताओं की सभी जातियों, समुदायों और क्षेत्रों में व्यापक लोकप्रियता थी।

questions.text: 1962 में चीन द्वारा भारत पर किए गए आक्रमण के प्रभाव का विश्लेषण कीजिए।
questions.text_english: Analyse the impact of Chinese invasion on India in 1962.

key_points: Military humiliation and loss of territory
Shattered the Panchsheel era of goodwill; India's foreign policy became more defence-oriented
key_points_hindi: सैन्य पराजय और क्षेत्र का नुकसान
पंचशील के युग का अंत; भारत की विदेश नीति रक्षा-उन्मुख हो गई

questions.solution: The Chinese invasion of India in 1962 had a profound impact. First, India suffered a severe military defeat and lost territory, which damaged national morale and exposed the weaknesses of the Indian Army. Second, it shattered the Panchsheel spirit and the era of 'Hindi-Chini Bhai Bhai' goodwill. India's foreign policy became more realistic and defence-oriented. The defeat also triggered a defence modernisation drive and strained Sino-Indian relations for decades.
questions.solution_hindi: 1962 में चीनी आक्रमण का भारत पर गहरा प्रभाव पड़ा। प्रथम, भारत को भारी सैन्य पराजय हुई और क्षेत्र का नुकसान हुआ जिससे राष्ट्रीय मनोबल टूटा। द्वितीय, पंचशील की भावना और 'हिंदी-चीनी भाई-भाई' की भावना समाप्त हो गई। भारत की विदेश नीति अधिक यथार्थवादी और रक्षा-उन्मुख हो गई।

questions.text: मिज़ोरम में हुए अलगाववादी आंदोलन के परिणाम का आकलन कीजिए।
questions.text_english: Assess the result of Secessionist Movement in Mizoram.

key_points: Signing of the Mizoram Peace Accord in 1986 between Rajiv Gandhi and Laldenga
Mizoram was granted statehood and Laldenga became Chief Minister
key_points_hindi: 1986 में राजीव गाँधी और लालडेंगा के बीच मिज़ोरम शांति समझौते पर हस्ताक्षर
मिज़ोरम को राज्य का दर्जा मिला और लालडेंगा मुख्यमंत्री बने

questions.solution: The secessionist movement in Mizoram, led by Laldenga and the Mizo National Front (MNF), began in the 1960s following the Great Famine. After years of insurgency, the movement culminated in the signing of the historic Mizoram Peace Accord in 1986 between Prime Minister Rajiv Gandhi and MNF leader Laldenga. As a result, Mizoram was upgraded from a Union Territory to a full-fledged state, and Laldenga became its first Chief Minister, bringing peace and normalcy to the region.
questions.solution_hindi: मिज़ोरम में लालडेंगा के नेतृत्व में मिज़ो नेशनल फ्रंट द्वारा चलाया गया अलगाववादी आंदोलन 1960 के दशक में शुरू हुआ था। वर्षों के विद्रोह के बाद 1986 में प्रधानमंत्री राजीव गाँधी और लालडेंगा के बीच मिज़ोरम शांति समझौते पर हस्ताक्षर हुए। परिणामस्वरूप मिज़ोरम को पूर्ण राज्य का दर्जा मिला और लालडेंगा पहले मुख्यमंत्री बने।

questions.text: क्या समाजवादी अर्थव्यवस्था से पूँजीवादी अर्थव्यवस्था तक लाने के लिए शॉक थेरेपी आवश्यक थी ? अपने उत्तर के पक्ष में दो तर्क लिखिए।
questions.text_english: Was Shock therapy necessary for making a transition from Socialist economy to Capitalist economy ? Support your answer with two arguments.

key_points: Introduction — Shock therapy was a rapid, radical economic transition prescribed for post-Soviet states
Argument against (or for) — sudden privatisation destroyed industries and caused economic chaos
Argument — gradualism could have preserved social welfare while introducing market reforms
Result — shock therapy caused massive unemployment and poverty in most post-Soviet economies
Conclusion — a more gradual and planned approach would have been more appropriate
key_points_hindi: शॉक थेरेपी — सोवियत देशों के लिए निर्धारित एक तेज़, आमूल आर्थिक बदलाव
तर्क — अचानक निजीकरण से उद्योग नष्ट हुए और आर्थिक अव्यवस्था फैली
तर्क — क्रमिक सुधार से सामाजिक कल्याण सुरक्षित रहता
परिणाम — अधिकांश देशों में भारी बेरोजगारी और गरीबी
निष्कर्ष — क्रमिक और नियोजित दृष्टिकोण अधिक उपयुक्त होता

questions.solution: Shock therapy was not necessary for transitioning from a socialist to a capitalist economy. This can be supported with two arguments. First, shock therapy led to devastating economic consequences in post-Soviet states. The rapid and unplanned privatisation of state enterprises resulted in the collapse of industries, massive unemployment, and a dramatic fall in living standards. Countries like Russia saw their GDP fall sharply and the rise of 'oligarchs' who captured public wealth, creating inequality rather than prosperity. Second, a gradualist approach — as demonstrated by China — proved far more effective. China introduced market reforms slowly, maintaining state control over key sectors while gradually opening the economy. This resulted in sustained high economic growth without the social disruption witnessed in shock therapy countries. Therefore, a measured and phased transition would have been more appropriate than the sudden and radical shift that shock therapy demanded.
questions.solution_hindi: समाजवादी से पूँजीवादी अर्थव्यवस्था की ओर संक्रमण के लिए शॉक थेरेपी आवश्यक नहीं थी। इसके समर्थन में दो तर्क इस प्रकार हैं। प्रथम, शॉक थेरेपी के विनाशकारी आर्थिक परिणाम हुए। सोवियत देशों में अचानक निजीकरण से उद्योग ध्वस्त हो गए, भारी बेरोजगारी और गरीबी बढ़ी। रूस में GDP तेजी से गिरी और 'ऑलिगार्क' वर्ग ने सार्वजनिक संपदा पर कब्जा किया जिससे असमानता बढ़ी। द्वितीय, चीन ने क्रमिक सुधारों का मार्ग चुना — धीरे-धीरे बाज़ार अर्थव्यवस्था अपनाई और प्रमुख क्षेत्रों में राज्य का नियंत्रण बनाए रखा। इससे निरंतर उच्च आर्थिक विकास हुआ बिना सामाजिक उथल-पुथल के। इसलिए एक क्रमिक और नियोजित दृष्टिकोण शॉक थेरेपी से अधिक उचित होता।

questions.instruction_line: निम्नलिखित में से केवल एक प्रश्न का उत्तर लिखिए।
questions.instruction_line_english: Answer only one of the following.

sub_questions.text: बदलती हुई परिस्थितियों में संयुक्त राष्ट्र को अधिक प्रासंगिक बनाने के लिए सितंबर 2005 में सभी सदस्य देशों के अध्यक्षों द्वारा लिए गए निर्णय के अनुसार उठाए जाने वाले किन्हीं चार कदमों का उल्लेख कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: State any four steps that the heads of all the member countries had decided to take in September 2005 to make the United Nations more relevant in the changing context.

key_points: Commitment to achieve Millennium Development Goals
Responsibility to Protect civilians from genocide and crimes against humanity
Establishment of Peacebuilding Commission
Creation of Human Rights Council
Agreement to double development aid to African nations

sub_questions.solution: In September 2005, the World Summit of UN member state leaders decided to take several important steps to make the UN more relevant. First, they reaffirmed their commitment to achieve the Millennium Development Goals (MDGs) by 2015, focusing on poverty reduction and human development. Second, they endorsed the principle of Responsibility to Protect (R2P), affirming that the international community has the right to intervene when a state fails to protect its citizens from genocide or crimes against humanity. Third, they agreed to establish a Peacebuilding Commission to help countries emerging from conflict. Fourth, they decided to create a new Human Rights Council to replace the older Human Rights Commission and strengthen the protection of human rights globally.

sub_questions.text: शीत युद्ध की समाप्ति के बाद विश्व में घटित हुए किन्हीं चार परिवर्तनों का उल्लेख कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: State any four changes that have occurred in the world after the end of the Cold War.

key_points: End of bipolar world — US became the sole superpower
Rise of regional organisations — ASEAN, EU strengthened
Globalisation accelerated
Ethnic conflicts and civil wars increased

sub_questions.solution: After the end of the Cold War, several significant changes occurred in the world. First, the bipolar world order ended and the United States emerged as the sole superpower, ushering in a unipolar era. Second, globalisation accelerated as market economies spread globally and trade and investment barriers were reduced. Third, regional organisations like the European Union and ASEAN gained greater importance and influence in international affairs. Fourth, new conflicts emerged including ethnic and civil wars in regions like the Balkans, Africa, and Central Asia, as suppressed tensions that had been held in check during the Cold War erupted into violence.

questions.text: ऐसी किन्हीं चार पर्यावरणीय चिंताओं की व्याख्या कीजिए जो वैश्विक राजनीति के लिए महत्त्वपूर्ण बन चुकी हैं।
questions.text_english: Explain any four environmental concerns that have become important for global politics.

key_points: Global warming and climate change
Depletion of the ozone layer
Loss of biodiversity
Deforestation and desertification
key_points_hindi: वैश्विक तापमान वृद्धि और जलवायु परिवर्तन
ओज़ोन परत का ह्रास
जैव विविधता की हानि
वनों की कटाई और मरुस्थलीकरण

questions.solution: Four major environmental concerns that have become crucial for global politics are: First, global warming and climate change caused by rising greenhouse gas emissions are threatening ecosystems, sea levels, and weather patterns worldwide, prompting international agreements like the Paris Accord. Second, depletion of the ozone layer due to chlorofluorocarbons (CFCs) led to the landmark Montreal Protocol in 1987, demonstrating how environmental issues can generate global political cooperation. Third, loss of biodiversity through habitat destruction endangers countless species and disrupts ecological balance, requiring global conservation strategies. Fourth, deforestation and desertification — especially in tropical regions — are destroying natural resources that communities depend on, making it a critical issue in global environmental negotiations such as those under the UN Framework Convention on Climate Change.
questions.solution_hindi: वैश्विक राजनीति के लिए महत्त्वपूर्ण चार पर्यावरणीय चिंताएँ: प्रथम, वैश्विक तापमान वृद्धि और जलवायु परिवर्तन — ग्रीनहाउस गैसों के उत्सर्जन से पारिस्थितिकी तंत्र और समुद्र स्तर को खतरा है जिसके लिए पेरिस समझौता जैसे अंतरराष्ट्रीय प्रयास हुए। द्वितीय, ओज़ोन परत का ह्रास — CFCs के कारण, 1987 में मॉन्ट्रियल प्रोटोकॉल हस्ताक्षरित हुआ। तृतीय, जैव विविधता की हानि — आवास विनाश से अनेक प्रजातियाँ खतरे में हैं। चतुर्थ, वनों की कटाई और मरुस्थलीकरण — प्राकृतिक संसाधनों का विनाश वैश्विक वार्ता का महत्त्वपूर्ण विषय बन गया है।

questions.text: भारत में पाँचवें आम चुनाव से पूर्व घटी किन्हीं दो महत्त्वपूर्ण राजनीतिक घटनाओं का विश्लेषण कीजिए।
questions.text_english: Analyse any two important political happenings in India before the fifth general elections.

key_points: Imposition of National Emergency in 1975 by Indira Gandhi
Split in the Congress Party — formation of Congress (O) vs Congress (R)
key_points_hindi: 1975 में इंदिरा गाँधी द्वारा राष्ट्रीय आपातकाल की घोषणा
कांग्रेस पार्टी में विभाजन — कांग्रेस (ओ) बनाम कांग्रेस (आर)

questions.solution: Before the fifth general elections (1971), two important political events shaped Indian politics. First, the Congress Party split in 1969 into Congress (O) led by the old guard and Congress (R) led by Indira Gandhi. Indira Gandhi's faction nationalised banks and abolished privy purses, projecting a pro-poor image. This gave her enormous popularity and enabled Congress (R) to win a massive majority in the 1971 elections with the slogan 'Garibi Hatao.' Second, the 1971 Bangladesh War further boosted Indira Gandhi's stature as a decisive and effective leader, consolidating her political dominance on the eve of the fifth general elections.
questions.solution_hindi: पाँचवें आम चुनाव (1971) से पूर्व दो प्रमुख राजनीतिक घटनाएँ: प्रथम, 1969 में कांग्रेस पार्टी का विभाजन — पुराने नेताओं की कांग्रेस (ओ) और इंदिरा गाँधी की कांग्रेस (आर)। इंदिरा गाँधी ने बैंकों का राष्ट्रीयकरण किया और प्रिवी पर्स समाप्त किए। द्वितीय, 1971 में बांग्लादेश युद्ध में भारत की जीत ने इंदिरा गाँधी की छवि और भी मजबूत की तथा 'गरीबी हटाओ' नारे के साथ उन्होंने 1971 का चुनाव भारी बहुमत से जीता।
questions.topic: Political Events before Fifth General Elections

questions.instruction_line: निम्नलिखित में से केवल एक प्रश्न का उत्तर लिखिए।
questions.instruction_line_english: Answer only one of the following.

sub_questions.text: 1975 में लगाए गए आपातकाल से सीखे गए किन्हीं दो सबकों (पाठों) की व्याख्या कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Explain any two lessons learnt from the emergency imposed in 1975.

key_points: Democracy is too deeply rooted for authoritarian rule to survive for long
Importance of free press and civil liberties for democracy

sub_questions.solution: The Emergency of 1975 taught India two crucial lessons. First, it demonstrated that Indian democracy had strong roots — despite the suppression of civil liberties, the people of India rejected authoritarianism decisively in the 1977 elections, proving that citizens valued democracy and were ready to defend it at the ballot box. Second, it highlighted the vital importance of a free press and independent judiciary for democracy. The emergency showed what happens when these pillars are undermined — censorship of the press and subservience of the judiciary allowed the abuse of power to go unchecked.

sub_questions.text: 1975 में राष्ट्रीय आपातकाल घोषित करने के लिए सरकार द्वारा दिए गए किन्हीं दो कारणों की व्याख्या कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Explain any two reasons that the government gave for imposing national emergency in 1975.

key_points: Threat to internal security and law and order breakdown
Allahabad High Court verdict against Indira Gandhi and political instability

sub_questions.solution: The government gave two major reasons for imposing the National Emergency in June 1975. First, it cited a threat to the internal security of the country and a breakdown of law and order, referring to the nationwide movement led by Jayaprakash Narayan, which the government claimed was a conspiracy to overthrow the legally elected government. Second, following the Allahabad High Court's verdict that invalidated Indira Gandhi's election on grounds of electoral malpractice, opposition parties intensified their demands for her resignation. The government used this political instability as justification, arguing that the nation faced an internal disturbance that required emergency powers to maintain governance.

questions.text:
निम्नलिखित अवतरण को ध्यानपूर्वक पढ़िए और इस पर आधारित प्रश्नों के उत्तर दीजिए :

"ऐतिहासिक रूप से तिब्बत भारत और चीन के बीच विवाद का एक बड़ा मसला रहा है। अतीत में समय-समय पर चीन ने तिब्बत पर अपना प्रशासनिक नियंत्रण जताया और कई दफा तिब्बत आज़ाद भी हुआ। 1950 में चीन ने तिब्बत पर नियंत्रण कर लिया। तिब्बत के ज़्यादातर लोगों ने चीनी कब्जे का विरोध किया। 1956 में चीन के शासनाध्यक्ष भारत के आधिकारिक दौरे पर तिब्बत के नेता के साथ पहुँचे।"
questions.text_english:
Read the following passage carefully and answer the questions based on it :

"Tibet is one of the major issues that historically caused tension between India and China. From time to time in history, China had claimed administrative control over Tibet and from time to time, Tibet was independent too. In 1950, China took over the control of Tibet. Large sections of the Tibetan population opposed this takeover. The Tibetan leader accompanied the Chinese Premier during his official visit to India in 1956."

sub_questions.text: तिब्बत का पठार कहाँ स्थित है ?
sub_questions.text_english: Where is the plateau of Tibet situated ?
sub_questions.solution: The correct answer is (A) Central Asia. The Tibetan Plateau, often called the 'Roof of the World', is situated in Central Asia. It is the world's highest and largest plateau, lying between the Himalayas to the south and the Taklamakan Desert to the north.

sub_questions.text: 1956 में चीन के कौन-से नेता चीन के शासनाध्यक्ष के रूप में भारत आए थे ?
sub_questions.text_english: Choose the name of the Chinese leader that came to India in 1956 as the Chinese Premier.
sub_questions.solution: The correct answer is (C) Zhou Enlai. Zhou Enlai was the Premier of China who visited India officially in 1956. The Dalai Lama, the Tibetan spiritual leader, accompanied him during this visit. Mao Zedong was the Chairman of China, not its Premier, and did not visit India. Hu-Zintao is incorrect as he was a later leader.

sub_questions.text: 'पंचशील समझौते' पर भारत और चीन के बीच किस वर्ष हस्ताक्षर किए गए ?
sub_questions.text_english: In which year was the 'Panchsheel agreement' signed between India and China ?
sub_questions.solution: The correct answer is (C) 1954. The Panchsheel Agreement (Five Principles of Peaceful Coexistence) was signed between India and China in April 1954. It was part of the agreement on trade and intercourse between the Tibet region of China and India. The five principles included mutual respect for sovereignty, non-aggression, non-interference, equality and cooperation, and peaceful coexistence.

sub_questions.text: दलाई लामा ने किस देश से शरण माँगी थी ?
sub_questions.text_english: From which country did Dalai Lama ask for asylum ?
sub_questions.solution: The correct answer is (C) India. After the failed Tibetan uprising against Chinese rule in 1959, the Dalai Lama fled Tibet and sought political asylum in India. India granted him asylum and he has lived in Dharamshala, Himachal Pradesh, since then. This decision strained Sino-Indian relations significantly.

भारत के दिए गए राजनीतिक रेखा-मानचित्र (पृष्ठ 13 पर), में चार राज्यों को (A), (B), (C) और (D) के रूप में अंकित किया गया है। नीचे दी गई जानकारी के आधार पर, इन राज्यों की पहचान कीजिए और अपनी उत्तर-पुस्तिका में इनके सही नाम, प्रयोग की गई जानकारी की क्रम संख्या तथा मानचित्र में दिया गया संबंधित अक्षर, नीचे दी गई तालिका के रूप में लिखिए :

questions.text: नीचे दिए गए कार्टून का अध्ययन कीजिए और इस पर आधारित प्रश्नों के उत्तर दीजिए :
questions.text_english: Study the cartoon given below and answer the questions based on it :

sub_questions.text: छड़ी के एक सिरे पर बैठा 'शेर' किस समुदाय का प्रतिनिधित्व कर रहा है ?
sub_questions.text_english: Which community is being represented by the 'Lion' sitting on the one end of the stick ?
sub_questions.solution: The correct answer is (C) Sinhalas. In Sri Lanka, the lion is the national symbol of the Sinhala community and appears on the Sri Lankan national flag. The cartoon depicts the Rajapakse government (labeled on the middle figure) caught between the Sinhala community (represented by the lion) and the Tamil insurgent group LTTE (represented by the tiger). This symbolism is well-established in the context of the Sri Lankan ethnic conflict.

sub_questions.text: कार्टून में दिखाए गए बाघ (टाइगर) पर लिखे शब्द 'LTTE' का क्या अर्थ है ?
sub_questions.text_english: What is the meaning of 'LTTE' written on the Tiger shown in the cartoon ?
sub_questions.solution: The correct answer is (C) Liberation Tigers of Tamil Eelam. The LTTE (Liberation Tigers of Tamil Eelam) was a separatist organisation in Sri Lanka that fought for an independent Tamil state called 'Eelam' in the northern and eastern parts of the country. It was founded by Velupillai Prabhakaran and was active from 1976 until its military defeat in 2009.

sub_questions.text: श्रीलंका में कौन-से समुदाय ने भेदभाव को अनुभव किया था ?
sub_questions.text_english: Which community in Sri Lanka had felt discriminated ?
sub_questions.solution: The correct answer is (A) Tamils. The Tamil community in Sri Lanka felt discriminated against by the Sinhala-dominated government after independence. Policies such as the 'Sinhala Only' language act of 1956, which made Sinhala the sole official language, and preferences given to the Sinhala majority in government jobs and higher education, led the Tamil minority to feel politically and economically marginalised.

sub_questions.text: कार्टून कौन-सी समस्या को दर्शा रहा है ?
sub_questions.text_english: Which problem is being depicted by the cartoon ?
sub_questions.solution: The correct answer is (D) Ethnic conflict. The cartoon depicts the Sri Lankan ethnic conflict between the Sinhala majority (represented by the lion) and the Tamil separatist group LTTE (represented by the tiger), with the Rajapakse government caught between the two forces. This is fundamentally an ethnic conflict rooted in differences of language, religion, and cultural identity between the Sinhalese and Tamil communities of Sri Lanka.

questions.instruction_line: निम्नलिखित में से केवल एक प्रश्न का उत्तर लिखिए।

sub_questions.text: यूरोपीय संघ को एक प्रभावशाली क्षेत्रीय संगठन बनाने वाले किन्हीं तीन कारकों की व्याख्या कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Explain any three factors that make the European Union an effective regional organisation.

key_points: Economic strength — world's largest trading bloc with a common market and Euro currency
Political integration — common foreign and security policy among member states
Institutional framework — European Parliament, European Court of Justice, European Commission

sub_questions.solution: The European Union is one of the world's most effective regional organisations for three main reasons. First, it possesses enormous economic strength. The EU functions as the world's largest single market, allowing the free movement of goods, services, capital, and people. The adoption of the Euro as a common currency by most member states has further deepened economic integration, making the EU a major global trading power. Second, the EU has achieved significant political and security integration. Member states coordinate their foreign and security policies, enabling the EU to speak with a relatively unified voice on international issues. It has also expanded its role in conflict prevention and peacekeeping operations. Third, the EU is supported by a strong institutional framework including the European Parliament (a democratically elected legislature), the European Commission (an executive body), and the European Court of Justice, which ensures that EU law is uniformly applied across all member states. These institutions give the EU a supranational character that no other regional organisation has achieved.

sub_questions.text: चीन में किए गए किन्हीं तीन परिवर्तनों की व्याख्या कीजिए जिससे इसकी अर्थव्यवस्था का उत्थान हुआ।
sub_questions.text_english: Explain any three changes made in China that raised the growth of its economy.

key_points: Special Economic Zones (SEZs) opened to attract foreign investment
Decollectivisation of agriculture allowing farmers to sell surplus in markets
Privatisation of state-owned enterprises and opening of trade

sub_questions.solution: China's remarkable economic growth was driven by three major reforms introduced after 1978. First, China set up Special Economic Zones (SEZs) — geographically delimited areas offering tax exemptions and relaxed regulations to attract foreign direct investment and technology. These zones became engines of export-led growth and transformed China into the world's manufacturing hub. Second, China decollectivised agriculture, ending the communist collective farming system. Farmers were now allowed to lease land and sell surplus produce in the open market. This dramatically increased agricultural productivity and rural incomes, freeing up labour for the industrial sector. Third, China gradually privatised many state-owned enterprises and opened its economy to international trade. Private entrepreneurship was encouraged, and entry into the WTO in 2001 further integrated China into the global economy, boosting its exports and fuelling decades of double-digit GDP growth.

sub_questions.text: अपारंपरिक सुरक्षा के लिए खतरों के किन्हीं तीन नए स्रोतों की व्याख्या कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Explain any three new sources of threats to non-traditional security.

key_points: Terrorism
Global pandemics and health threats
Climate change and environmental degradation

sub_questions.solution: Non-traditional security threats are those that go beyond military conflict between states. Three major new sources of such threats are: First, global terrorism has emerged as a severe threat to non-traditional security. Transnational terrorist organisations like Al-Qaeda and ISIS operate across borders, targeting civilians and destabilising governments. The 9/11 attacks demonstrated how terrorism could strike even the most powerful nations. Second, global pandemics such as COVID-19 have revealed how infectious diseases can threaten human security on a massive scale, disrupting economies, overwhelming health systems, and causing millions of deaths worldwide — all without a single military engagement. Third, climate change and environmental degradation pose an existential non-traditional security threat. Rising sea levels, extreme weather events, and resource scarcity driven by global warming are already displacing populations, causing humanitarian crises, and straining interstate relations, particularly in climate-vulnerable nations.

sub_questions.text: पारम्परिक सुरक्षा नीति के किन्हीं तीन घटकों की व्याख्या कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Explain any three components of traditional security policy.

key_points: Deterrence — preventing attack by threatening unacceptable costs on the aggressor
Alliance building — joining coalitions to increase collective security
Balance of power — maintaining equilibrium so no single state dominates

sub_questions.solution: Traditional security policy focuses on protecting the state from external military threats. Its three key components are: First, deterrence — the strategy of preventing an adversary from attacking by convincing it that the cost of such an attack would be unacceptably high. Nuclear deterrence during the Cold War is the classic example, where both superpowers maintained large arsenals to prevent each other from launching a first strike. Second, alliance building — states form military alliances to increase their collective security. NATO and the Warsaw Pact were prime examples during the Cold War. Alliances allow states to pool resources and present a unified defence against common threats. Third, balance of power — states seek to maintain a rough equilibrium in military and economic capabilities so that no single state can dominate the international system. Historically, European states formed coalitions to prevent any one power — like Napoleon's France or Hitler's Germany — from achieving continental hegemony.

sub_questions.text: 1947 में ब्रिटिश इंडिया के विभाजन के किन्हीं चार परिणामों का वर्णन कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Describe any four consequences of the partition of British India in 1947.

key_points: Massive displacement — about 15 million people uprooted from their homes
Communal violence — hundreds of thousands killed in riots
Creation of two new nations — India and Pakistan
Refugee crisis and administrative challenges

sub_questions.solution: The partition of British India in 1947 had four major consequences. First, it led to the largest mass migration in human history — approximately 15 million people (Hindus, Muslims, and Sikhs) were uprooted from their homes and forced to cross the newly drawn border between India and Pakistan in both directions. Second, the partition was accompanied by horrific communal violence. Riots, massacres, and acts of revenge claimed the lives of hundreds of thousands of people across Punjab, Bengal, and other areas, leaving deep social wounds. Third, it resulted in the creation of two independent nation-states — the Republic of India and the Dominion of Pakistan (which later split into Pakistan and Bangladesh in 1971) — each inheriting different legacies and challenges. Fourth, both new nations faced a severe refugee crisis. Millions of displaced people needed rehabilitation, food, shelter, and economic support, placing enormous strain on the administrative and financial resources of both governments in their early years.

sub_questions.text: हैदराबाद रियासत के भारत में शामिल होने से पूर्व उससे जुड़ी किन्हीं चार घटनाओं का वर्णन कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Describe any four events related to the princely state of Hyderabad prior to its accession to India.

key_points: The Nizam refused to accede to India and sought an independent status
The Razakars — a para-military force — terrorised the population and opposed accession
India imposed an economic blockade of Hyderabad
Operation Polo — Indian Army's police action in September 1948 led to accession

sub_questions.solution: Four important events related to Hyderabad before its accession to India are: First, the Nizam of Hyderabad, Mir Osman Ali Khan, refused to join either India or Pakistan and sought to remain independent as a sovereign state. He even approached the United Nations seeking recognition, which created a diplomatic crisis for India. Second, the Nizam encouraged and relied on the Razakars — an extremist para-military organisation led by Qasim Razvi — who terrorised the local Hindu population, committed violence against those favouring accession, and created instability within Hyderabad. Third, India imposed an economic blockade on Hyderabad to pressure the Nizam into joining the Indian Union. The blockade disrupted trade and created shortages, but the Nizam remained defiant and continued negotiations. Fourth, when all diplomatic efforts failed, the Indian government ordered 'Operation Polo' (also called the Police Action) in September 1948. The Indian Army marched into Hyderabad, the Nizam's forces were quickly defeated, and Hyderabad was formally integrated into the Indian Union within five days.

sub_questions.text: "अनेक महत्त्वपूर्ण मुद्दों पर, भारत में अधिकांश राजनीतिक पार्टियों के बीच एक व्यापक सहमति उभरी है।" किन्हीं तीन उदाहरणों से इस कथन का समर्थन कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: "On many crucial issues, a broad agreement has emerged among most political parties in India." Support the statement with any three examples.

key_points: Agreement on economic liberalisation and continuation of LPG reforms
Consensus on new social and economic priorities — OBC reservations, rural employment schemes
Broad agreement on maintaining a democratic federal structure and not reversing it

sub_questions.solution: The statement that a broad consensus has emerged among most Indian political parties on crucial issues can be supported with three examples. First, almost all major political parties — the BJP, Congress, regional parties — have accepted the framework of economic liberalisation initiated in 1991. Despite ideological differences, none has seriously proposed reversing LPG (Liberalisation, Privatisation, Globalisation) reforms. This represents a fundamental agreement on India's economic direction. Second, there is broad political consensus on the need for social justice through reservations and welfare schemes. When the National Front government implemented the Mandal Commission recommendations for OBC reservations in 1990, it eventually became accepted across party lines as parties sought OBC electoral support. Third, the political class as a whole, across parties, has shown consistent commitment to democracy and federalism. No mainstream party has advocated abolishing elections or centralising power to undermine state governments in the long run, reflecting a shared consensus on India's democratic constitutional framework.

sub_questions.text: "राष्ट्रीय मोर्चा की सरकार द्वारा मंडल आयोग की सिफारिशों को लागू करने के निश्चय से अन्य पिछड़े वर्गों (ओ.बी.सी.) का राजनीति में उदय हुआ।" तीन उदाहरणों अथवा तर्कों से कथन की पुष्टि कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: "The decision of the National Front government to implement the recommendations of the Mandal Commission helped in shaping the politics of Other Backward Classes (OBCs)." Support the statement with three examples or arguments.

key_points: OBC leaders came to occupy prominent political positions as parties sought their support
Rise of caste-based regional parties like Samajwadi Party and RJD championing OBC interests
Increase in OBC representation in Parliament and state legislatures

sub_questions.solution: The implementation of Mandal Commission recommendations in 1990 by the National Front government under V.P. Singh proved to be a watershed moment in Indian politics, shaping OBC political assertion in three significant ways. First, the decision triggered intense political mobilisation of OBC communities. Parties across the political spectrum began actively courting OBC voters and fielding OBC candidates. This led to a dramatic increase in OBC representation in Parliament and state assemblies, as political parties recognised the electoral arithmetic. Second, several powerful regional parties emerged specifically to champion OBC causes. The Samajwadi Party in Uttar Pradesh under Mulayam Singh Yadav and the Rashtriya Janata Dal in Bihar under Lalu Prasad Yadav built their political base primarily on OBC and minority consolidation, transforming the political landscape of these states. Third, prominent OBC leaders rose to become Chief Ministers and hold powerful cabinet positions across multiple states. This political visibility gave OBCs a sense of empowerment and identity that went beyond reservations, fundamentally altering the social composition of India's political leadership.
